text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock E at losses reminded me that avoiding a realized loss is not a sound reason to keep a holding; I should reassess its prospects and downside risk.","After several months without trades, the account fell from its Period 7 high. I should set a regular review schedule and act when my portfolio risk or investment thesis changes, rather than letting inattention decide.","I should judge each position by its future return and role in the portfolio, not by whether its price is above my average cost or by the gain I have already made."]}
